title: Slip past lips of memory's swinging hips while it seizes all it pleases in silence eyeing violence sung in a cadence of can't #smallpoems
summary: Slip past lips of memory's swinging hips while it seizes all it pleases in silence eyeing violence sung in a cadence of can't #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Slip
   past
lips
  of memory's
swinging hips
while it seizes
all it pleases
  in
silence
 eyeing
violence
    sung in a
cadence of can't
#smallpoems
